arms.hypothesis: A learned sparse FFN helps when placed at the measured conflict peak.

arms.falsifier: Frozen matches or exceeds learned without collapse.
arms.milestone_pruning_rule: stop if broken, collapsed, or dominated on paired accuracy and mechanism
